faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes R350 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: The R350 CDI uses the OM642 — a 3.0-litre V6 diesel. This was the only engine fitted to the R350 CDI throughout its entire 2006–2013 production run.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes R350 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my R350 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Your R350 CDI has the OM642. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 R350 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used R350 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my R350 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an R350 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most R350 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
